snippet.title: HYPERBEAT Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
HYPERBEAT is a fast-paced precision rhythm game. The game features an original soundtrack of over 90 minutes of music, 20 playable songs, character customization, and a diverse cast of characters to meet.

The game is releasing October 22. We are aiming to release on consoles as well, but stay tuned for news on that until post-Steam launch. 

Check us out on steam here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2263360/HYPERBEAT/
Join the discord here: https://discord.gg/7hNQbm82Vu
